title: THE SIT-DOWN
question: Among source neurons with comparable hotspot opportunity, what source-level graph properties distinguish the most recurrent hotspot-producing sources from matched low-recurrence sources?

universe.candidate_sources: all unique pre labels represented by the frozen 114825 SQ-03F candidate edges

hotspot_sets.S: reuse exact SQ-03F S hotspot membership
hotspot_sets.C: reuse exact SQ-03F C hotspot membership

made_source_definition.ranking: hotspot-edge count per source DESC, source label ASC
made_source_definition.selection: exact top 1% of candidate sources by hotspot-edge count, separately for S and C; k = ceil(candidate_source_count * 0.01)
made_source_definition.eligibility: source must contribute at least one hotspot edge
made_source_definition.ties: source label ASC; exact k; no tie expansion

control_definition.pool: candidate sources outside the current made-source set
control_definition.selection_order: made sources in recurrence-count DESC, source label ASC; choose control minimizing absolute candidate-edge-count difference, then absolute sum-context-count difference, then absolute distinct-context-count difference, then source label ASC
control_definition.failure_rule: record unmatched; do not widen bins

audits: overlap of S-made and C-made source sets

frozen_interpretation: If made sources retain greater out-strength or heavier outgoing weights after opportunity matching, recurrent hotspot production is associated with source-level network properties beyond opportunity alone.
If feature differences collapse under source-level opportunity matching, the SQ-03F.2 source phenotype is compatible with the same opportunity structure that drives recurrence.
Concentration and target-diversity metrics are descriptive model-level features only and do not define a biological neuron class.

family_model.translation: Put a made source across the table from a source with the same number of jobs and ask what is actually different about the operation.
family_model.firewall: Family Model language is presentation-only and has no scientific authority.

claim_boundary: SQ-03F.4 may describe graph properties associated with recurrent hotspot-producing sources after explicit source-opportunity matching inside the frozen model. It does not establish biological neuron classes, sex mechanisms, living-fly behavior, population effects, or financial utility.
